source.titleEnglishInternal: Decline the Offer to Scrape the Almonds Off
source.objectiveEnglishInternal: Refuse a well-meant but unsafe offer for an allergic friend and ask for a safe option or none at all.
source.speakingEnglishInternal: You are with your friend Kenji, who has a tree-nut allergy, and the AI is Jordi, a server at a granja in Gràcia: thank him warmly but turn down his offer with negative commands like no la raspes and no recomiendo que + subjunctive, then ask for a safe option or nothing at all.

archivedDraft.scene: At a bakery café, a server offers to remove almond pieces from a pastry; the guests decline and ask for current labeling and preparation information.

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Catalan flat sweet pastry, often topped with almonds or pine nuts.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: コカ（カタルーニャの菓子パン）

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: The term Spanish allergen labels use for tree nuts.
Spain: the workshop where pastries are made.
In Barcelona, a café known for hot chocolate, dairy and pastries.

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: the hot chocolate with whipped cream
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Classic order at a Barcelona granja.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ホイップクリーム入りのホットチョコレート
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: the hot chocolate with whipped cream

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Gracias, Jordi, pero no la raspes, por favor.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Thanks, Jordi, but please don't scrape it.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Informal (tú), normal with a server in Spain; la = la coca.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ありがとう、ジョルディ。でも、それを削り取らないでください。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Thanks, Jordi, but please don't scrape it.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Te lo agradezco mucho, de verdad, eres muy amable.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I really appreciate it, honestly, you're very kind.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 本当にありがとうございます。とても親切ですね。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I really appreciate it, honestly, you're very kind.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Tiene alergia grave a los frutos de cáscara.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: He has a severe tree-nut allergy.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 彼には重い木の実アレルギーがあります。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: He has a severe tree-nut allergy.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: No recomiendo que Kenji la pruebe, aunque quites las almendras.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I don't recommend Kenji try it, even if you remove the almonds.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: アーモンドを取り除いても、ケンジがそれを食べてみることは勧めません。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I don't recommend Kenji try it, even if you remove the almonds.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Kenji, no te la comas; quedan restos en la masa.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Kenji, don't eat it; there are bits left in the dough.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Informal negative command with pronouns: no te la comas.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ケンジ、それを食べないで。生地にかけらが残っているよ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Kenji, don't eat it; there are bits left in the dough.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: No insistas, Kenji; no merece la pena el riesgo.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Don't push it, Kenji; it's not worth the risk.

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ケンジ、無理に食べようとしないで。その危険を冒す価値はないよ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Don't push it, Kenji; it's not worth the risk.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: ¿Tienen algo envasado, con la etiqueta de alérgenos?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Do you have anything packaged, with the allergen label?
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Ustedes when you address the staff.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: アレルゲン表示のある包装済みの商品はありますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Do you have anything packaged, with the allergen label?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Si no hay una opción segura, prefiere no comer nada.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: If there's no safe option, he'd rather not eat anything.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 安全なものがなければ、彼は何も食べないほうを選びます。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: If there's no safe option, he'd rather not eat anything.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana y su amigo Kenji desayunan un sábado en una granja del barrio de Gràcia, en Barcelona.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana and her friend Kenji are having breakfast on a Saturday at a traditional café in the Gràcia neighborhood, in Barcelona.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 土曜日、アナと友人のケンジは、バルセロナのグラシア地区にある昔ながらのカフェで朝食をとっています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana and her friend Kenji are having breakfast on a Saturday at a traditional café in the Gràcia neighborhood, in Barcelona.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Kenji pide un suizo, y Jordi, el camarero, les recomienda la coca de la casa, recién salida del horno.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Kenji orders a hot chocolate with whipped cream, and Jordi, the server, recommends the house coca to them, fresh out of the oven.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ケンジはホイップクリーム入りのホットチョコレートを注文し、給仕のジョルディは焼きたての店のコカを二人に勧めます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Kenji orders a hot chocolate with whipped cream, and Jordi, the server, recommends the house coca to them, fresh out of the oven.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana mira la coca y ve que toda la superficie está cubierta de almendras.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana looks at the coca and sees that the whole surface is covered in almonds.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナがコカを見ると、表面全体がアーモンドで覆われています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana looks at the coca and sees that the whole surface is covered in almonds.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana señala a Kenji y le explica a Jordi: Tiene alergia grave a los frutos de cáscara.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana points to Kenji and explains to Jordi: He has a severe tree-nut allergy.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナはケンジを指してジョルディに説明します。「彼には重い木の実アレルギーがあります」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana points to Kenji and explains to Jordi: He has a severe tree-nut allergy.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Jordi, con mucha amabilidad, se ofrece a raspar las almendras de una porción para Kenji.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Jordi, with great kindness, offers to scrape the almonds off a slice for Kenji.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ジョルディは親切心から、ケンジのために一切れのアーモンドを削り取ることを申し出ます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Jordi, with great kindness, offers to scrape the almonds off a slice for Kenji.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana: Te lo agradezco mucho, de verdad, eres muy amable.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana: I really appreciate it, honestly, you're very kind.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナ：「本当にありがとうございます。とても親切ですね」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana: I really appreciate it, honestly, you're very kind.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana: Gracias, Jordi, pero no la raspes, por favor.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana: Thanks, Jordi, but please don't scrape it.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナ：「ありがとう、ジョルディ。でも、それを削り取らないでください」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana: Thanks, Jordi, but please don't scrape it.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana: No recomiendo que Kenji la pruebe, aunque quites las almendras.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana: I don't recommend Kenji try it, even if you remove the almonds.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナ：「アーモンドを取り除いても、ケンジがそれを食べてみることは勧めません」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana: I don't recommend Kenji try it, even if you remove the almonds.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Jordi admite que en el obrador preparan la masa en la misma mesa donde trabajan con almendras todo el día.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Jordi admits that in the bakery kitchen they make the dough on the same table where they work with almonds all day.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ジョルディは、製菓作業場では一日中アーモンドを扱う同じ台で生地を作っていると認めます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Jordi admits that in the bakery kitchen they make the dough on the same table where they work with almonds all day.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Kenji duda y dice que un trocito pequeño no le va a hacer daño.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Kenji hesitates and says that a small piece isn't going to hurt him.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ケンジはためらい、小さな一切れなら害はないだろうと言います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Kenji hesitates and says that a small piece isn't going to hurt him.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana: Kenji, no te la comas; quedan restos en la masa.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana: Kenji, don't eat it; there are bits left in the dough.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナ：「ケンジ、それを食べないで。生地にかけらが残っているよ」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana: Kenji, don't eat it; there are bits left in the dough.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana: No insistas, Kenji; no merece la pena el riesgo.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana: Don't push it, Kenji; it's not worth the risk.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナ：「ケンジ、無理に食べようとしないで。その危険を冒す価値はないよ」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana: Don't push it, Kenji; it's not worth the risk.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Kenji recuerda que el año pasado sufrió una anafilaxia por un trozo de turrón.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Kenji remembers that last year he had anaphylaxis from a piece of nougat.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ケンジは、昨年ヌガーを一切れ食べてアナフィラキシーを起こしたことを思い出します。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Kenji remembers that last year he had anaphylaxis from a piece of nougat.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Lleva su antihistamínico y su autoinyector, como le indicó su médico, y Ana sabe que, si hay síntomas, se usa el autoinyector y se llama al 112.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: He carries his antihistamine and his auto-injector, as his doctor told him, and Ana knows that, if there are symptoms, the auto-injector is used and 112 is called.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 医師の指示どおり、彼は抗ヒスタミン薬と自己注射器を携帯しています。アナは、症状が出たら自己注射器を使い、112に電話することを知っています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: He carries his antihistamine and his auto-injector, as his doctor told him, and Ana knows that, if there are symptoms, the auto-injector is used and 112 is called.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana: ¿Tienen algo envasado, con la etiqueta de alérgenos?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana: Do you have anything packaged, with the allergen label?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナ：「アレルゲン表示のある包装済みの商品はありますか」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana: Do you have anything packaged, with the allergen label?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Jordi trae un producto envasado, pero la etiqueta dice que puede contener trazas de frutos de cáscara.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Jordi brings a packaged product, but the label says it may contain traces of tree nuts.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ジョルディは包装済みの商品を持ってきますが、表示には「木の実類を微量に含む可能性があります」とあります。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Jordi brings a packaged product, but the label says it may contain traces of tree nuts.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Ana: Si no hay una opción segura, prefiere no comer nada.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Ana: If there's no safe option, he'd rather not eat anything.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: アナ：「安全なものがなければ、彼は何も食べないほうを選びます」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Ana: If there's no safe option, he'd rather not eat anything.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Jordi consulta la carta de alérgenos y confirma que el suizo no lleva frutos de cáscara entre sus ingredientes; Ana pregunta si se prepara con utensilios limpios, y Kenji decide pedirlo solo si la cocina lo confirma.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Jordi checks the allergen chart and confirms that the hot chocolate has no tree nuts among its ingredients; Ana asks whether it is prepared with clean utensils, and Kenji decides to order it only if the kitchen confirms.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ジョルディはアレルゲン一覧表を確認し、そのホットチョコレートの原材料に木の実類は含まれていないと伝えます。アナは清潔な器具で調理するか尋ね、ケンジは厨房が確認した場合にのみ注文することにします。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Jordi checks the allergen chart and confirms that the hot chocolate has no tree nuts among its ingredients; Ana asks whether it is prepared with clean utensils, and Kenji decides to order it only if the kitchen confirms.

speakingGoalJapaneseDraft: バルセロナのグラシア地区のカフェで、木の実アレルギーのある友人ケンジのために、給仕のジョルディに親切な提案へのお礼を伝え、アーモンドを削り取る方法は断り、アレルゲン表示と清潔な器具での調理を確認し、安全な選択肢がなければ何も注文しないと伝える。
sourceConflictInternal: The current 18-turn source follows Ana and Kenji at a Saturday café breakfast in Barcelona’s Gràcia district. Jordi offers to scrape almonds from coca, but bakery dough is made on a surface used for almonds all day. Kenji has a severe tree-nut allergy and a prior anaphylaxis. The source specifies his antihistamine and auto-injector, and 112 for symptoms; a packaged item warns of tree-nut traces, while hot chocolate requires a separate clean-utensil check. The archived 12-turn draft compresses these source facts and is retained as distinct evidence, not an answer or migration source.

reviewQuestionsInternal: 木の実類とナッツ類の範囲、アーモンドの位置づけと商品表示の語法を有資格の日本語・アレルギー用語レビュアーが確認する。
「重い木の実アレルギー」「アナフィラキシー」「抗ヒスタミン薬」「自己注射器」の文脈と、症状時の112への連絡というスペインの場面設定を専門家が確認する。
「コカ」「グランハ」「スイソ」のカタルーニャ・バルセロナ固有の食文化の表記と説明を確認する。
包装済み商品に木の実類を微量に含む可能性がある表示と、ホットチョコレートの原材料確認・清潔な器具確認という別の判断を混同しない。
否定命令と接続法のスペイン語文法目的は日本語に一対一対応しないため、自然な断りと非推奨の言い方として再設計する。
